intent.description: Path to the intent this spec answers to. CON_04 and CON_05 are both judged against it, so it is required.

approved_by.description: The person who approved this artifact. Written by them, not by a skill: it is the gate.

approved_at.description: When it was approved. Required alongside approved_by - a name with no date says nothing about which version was approved.

allOf.description: Approval is both fields or neither.
